CREATE OR ALTER FUNCTION [graph].[CheckCircularRelationshipCollision] ( @sourceUid uniqueidentifier, @targetUid uniqueidentifier, @predicateType int ) RETURNS bit AS BEGIN declare @maxLevel int = 20; declare @willCauseCircularRef bit = 0;
;WITH TraverseForward as ( select S.Uid, 0 as Level from Asset S where S.Uid = @sourceUid union all select T.Uid, AN.Level + 1 as Level from TraverseForward AN inner join Asset S on S.Uid = AN.Uid inner join PredicateIntersect I on I.Subject = S.Object and I.SubjectID = S.ObjectID and I.PredicateType = @predicateType inner join Asset T on T.Object = I.Object and T.ObjectID = I.ObjectID where AN.Level < @maxLevel ) select @willCauseCircularRef = 1 from TraverseForward where Uid = @targetUid OPTION (MAXRECURSION 100)
IF @willCauseCircularRef = 0 BEGIN ;with TraverseBackward as ( select S.Uid, 0 as Level from Asset S where S.Uid = @sourceUid union all select T.Uid, AN.Level + 1 as Level from TraverseBackward AN inner join Asset S on S.Uid = AN.Uid inner join PredicateIntersect I on I.Object = S.Object and I.ObjectID = S.ObjectID and I.PredicateType = @predicateType inner join Asset T on T.Object = I.Subject and T.ObjectID = I.SubjectID where AN.Level < @maxLevel ) select @willCauseCircularRef = 1 from TraverseBackward where Uid = @targetUid OPTION (MAXRECURSION 100) END
return @willCauseCircularRef END
changeSet.rollback:
CREATE OR ALTER FUNCTION [graph].[CheckCircularRelationshipCollision] ( @sourceUid uniqueidentifier, @targetUid uniqueidentifier, @predicateType int ) RETURNS bit AS BEGIN declare @maxLevel int = 20; declare @willCauseCircularRef bit = 0;
;WITH TraverseForward as ( select $node_id as NodeId, S.Uid, 0 as Level from graph.AssetNode S where S.Uid = @sourceUid union all select T.$node_id NodeId, T.Uid, AN.Level + 1 as Level from graph.AssetNode T inner join graph.AssetEdge E on T.$node_id = E.$to_id and E.PredicateType = @predicateType inner join TraverseForward AN on E.$from_id = AN.NodeId and AN.Level < @maxLevel ) select @willCauseCircularRef = 1 from TraverseForward where Uid = @targetUid OPTION (MAXRECURSION 100)
IF @willCauseCircularRef = 0 BEGIN ;with TraverseBackward as ( select $node_id as NodeId, S.Uid, 0 as Level from graph.AssetNode S where S.Uid = @sourceUid union all select T.$node_id NodeId, T.Uid, AN.Level + 1 as Level from graph.AssetNode T inner join graph.AssetEdge E on T.$node_id = E.$from_id and E.PredicateType = @predicateType inner join TraverseBackward AN on E.$to_id = AN.NodeId and AN.Level < @maxLevel ) select @willCauseCircularRef = 1 from TraverseBackward where Uid = @targetUid OPTION (MAXRECURSION 100) END
return @willCauseCircularRef END
